result.rationale: The server schema is `guests: z.array(z.string().email())` with no uniqueness refinement, and the handler's uniqueGuests filter only removes emails matching existing attendees (`booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)`) or the blacklist — duplicates within the submitted guests array are not filtered and would be created via createMany. The uniqueness check exists only client-side (ZAddGuestsInputSchema in AddGuestsDialog.tsx), so a direct API call bypasses it, exactly as the finding describes.
